installCommand: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
buildCommand: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma generate --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/prepare-vercel-api.mjs && mkdir -p prisma && cp backend/prisma/schema.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma generate && rm -rf prisma
